pairs: And the seventh month had arrived.
filii autem Israël erant in civitatibus suis.
Now the sons of Israel were in their cities.
Congregatusque est omnis populus quasi vir unus ad plateam quæ est ante portam aquarum:
And all the people were gathered together, like one man, in the street which is before the water gate.
et dixerunt Esdræ scribæ ut afferret librum legis Moysi,
And they spoke to Ezra the scribe, so that he would bring the book of the law of Moses,
which the Lord had instructed to Israel.
Attulit ergo Esdras sacerdos legem coram multitudine virorum
Ezra the priest brought the law before the multitude of men and women,
and all those who were able to understand,
on the first day of the seventh month.
Et legit in eo aperte in platea quæ erat ante portam aquarum,
And he read it openly in the street which was before the water gate,
de mane usque ad mediam diem,
in the sight of the men and women,
et aures omnis populi erant erectæ ad librum.
And the ears of all the people were attentive to the book.
Stetit autem Esdras scriba super gradum ligneum,
Then Ezra the scribe stood upon a step of wood,
which he had made for speaking.
And standing beside him were Mattithiah,
And on the left were Pedaiah,
Et aperuit Esdras librum coram omni populo:
And Ezra opened the book before all the people.
For he stood out above all the people.
And when he had opened it,
Et benedixit Esdras Domino Deo magno:
And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God.
et adoraverunt Deum proni in terram.
and they adored God, facing the ground.
silentium faciebant in populo ad audiendam legem:
caused the people to be silent in order to hear the law.
populus autem stabat in gradu suo.
And the people were standing on their feet.
Et legerunt in libro legis Dei distincte,
And they read from the book of the law of God,
distinctly and plainly, so as to be understood.
And when it was read, they did understand.
Dixit autem Nehemias (ipse est Athersatha) et Esdras sacerdos et scriba,
Then Nehemiah (the same is the cupbearer) and Ezra, the priest and scribe, and the Levites,
who were interpreting for all the people, said:
Dies sanctificatus est Domino Deo nostro:
“This day has been sanctified to the Lord our God. Do not mourn,
et nolite flere. Flebat enim omnis populus cum audiret verba legis.
For all of the people were weeping, as they were listening to the words of the law.
et mittite partes his qui non præparaverunt sibi,
and send portions to those who have not prepared for themselves.
For it is the holy day of the Lord.
gaudium etenim Domini est fortitudo nostra.
For the joy of the Lord is also our strength.”
Levitæ autem silentium faciebant in omni populo,
Then the Levites caused the people to be silent,
Abiit itaque omnis populus ut comederet,
And so all the people went forth,
so that they might eat and drink,
and so that they might send portions,
and so that they might make a great rejoicing.
quia intellexerant verba quæ docuerat eos.
For they understood the words that he had taught to them.
Et in die secundo congregati sunt principes familiarum universi populi,
the leaders of the families of all the people,
and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe,
so that he might interpret for them the words of the law.
Et invenerunt scriptum in lege præcepisse Dominum in manu Moysi ut habitent filii Israël in tabernaculis in die solemni, mense septimo:
And they found written in the law, which the Lord had instructed by the hand of Moses, that the sons of Israel should live in tabernacles on the day of solemnity in the seventh month,
et divulgent vocem in universis urbibus suis,
and send out a voice in all their cities
and the branches of beautiful trees,
and the branches of thick trees,”
so that they might make tabernacles,
And the people went forth and brought.
And they made for themselves tabernacles,
Feceruntque sibi tabernacula unusquisque in domate suo:
each one at his own dwelling,
and in the courts of the house of God,
and in the street of the water gate,
and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
Fecit ergo universa ecclesia eorum qui redierant de captivitate, tabernacula,
Therefore, the entire assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made tabernacles and lived in tabernacles.
For from the days of Jeshua,
non enim fecerant a diebus Josue filii Nun taliter filii Israël usque ad diem illum.
the son of Nun, even to that day, the sons of Israel had not done so.
And there was exceedingly great rejoicing.
Legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos,
Now he read in the book of the law of God, throughout each day,
a die primo usque ad diem novissimum.
from the first day even to the very last day.
And they kept the solemnity for seven days. And on the eighth day,
et in die octavo collectam juxta ritum.
there was a gathering according to the ritual.
